caption:
🚇 One day on the New York subway — 24 hours, every train.

8,348 scheduled trains across 459 stations, each dot a real train in its line colour. Watch the system breathe: thin before dawn, Manhattan saturating at rush hour — and, unlike most metros, it never fully stops. New York runs 24/7 🌙

📊 Data: MTA subway GTFS timetable for Thursday 3 September 2026 (data.ny.gov). Positions interpolated between stops; track layout reconstructed from station sequences.
